mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM gc_user_note AS n LEFT JOIN sys_file f on n.file_id=f.id WHERE n.user_id=#{userId} and n.video_id =#{videoId} and n.master_id=#{masterId} order by create_time asc
select count(1) from gc_user_note where video_id = #{videoId} and user_id = #{userId} and master_id = #{masterId}

select n.video_id, n.user_id, max(n.update_time) as update_time, count(n.file_id) as fileNum, v.id,v.video_name as videoName,s.master_id from gc_user_note n left join gc_video v on v.id=n.video_id left join gc_subject s on s.id=v.sub_id where n.user_id =#{userId} group by n.video_id, n.user_id, v.id, s.master_id
